purpose: Weapon and attachment asset namespace census for the 1.4.3.0 BF6 multiplayer Frosty audit. Candidate taxonomy only; no runtime conclusions.

source.pathGuidType: Catalog records contain path, guid, type, originalBytes, storedBytes, sha1; type is null for all 467208 records
source.collectionManifestStatus: partial; 23557 raw status records (23554 success, 3 failed)

method.reproduction: Load JSON and iterate assets[]. For namespace counts, compare path.casefold() against listed slash-delimited prefix. For lexical discovery, apply case-insensitive regex (weapon|firearm|rifle|pistol|shotgun|sniper|smg|lmg|ammo|magazine|muzzle|barrel|optic|sight|grip|stock|attachment|ballistic|recoil) to path. Art count uses case-insensitive segment regex (^|/)Art(/|$). Counts are asset records, not deduplicated GUIDs or gameplay objects.
limitations: Lexical matches are discovery evidence and are neither a complete candidate set nor an exclusion test.
Catalog path/type metadata does not establish mode ownership or runtime use.
Raw captures are partial; an absent body is not evidence that an asset is irrelevant.
Namespace and lexical counts overlap and must not be summed.

inclusionRules: Include all records under Common/Hardware/Weapons regardless of capitalization or Art, skin, texture, mesh, 1P/3P, or cosmetic-looking path components until dependency/ownership review proves an exclusion. This namespace includes weapon bases and attachment presentation as well as art dependencies.

Include Common/Gameplay/Weapons and Common/Gameplay/Loadouts. Examples include DefinitionSlots_Weapons/Handguard and loadout equipment records; these can express slots, selectable configurations, and equipment linkage outside the hardware tree.

Include weapon customization/equipment UI namespaces (Common/UI/WeaponCustomization, Common/UI/Weapons), plus Common/FX/Weapons, Common/Sound/Weapons, weapon-linked VO, and weapon-named animation assets as dependency candidates.

Include Common/Hardware/Gadgets weapon-like deployables and launchers when records identify launcher, minigun, combat weapon, ammunition, or weapon attachment roles. Relevant examples include Common/Hardware/Gadgets/Launchers and BattlePickups/Minigun.
Include win32/dpf and related packaged dependency records when names or dependency links identify a weapon, attachment, or weapon part.

Include candidate records in Game, Animations, DiceAI, Test, and Art paths when the asset identity, owner/dependency edge, or body points to an MP weapon/attachment. Folder names and lexical names alone set review priority, not final scope. Preserve shared and unresolved records.
exclusionEvidenceRules: Exclude a cosmetic only after positive evidence identifies the asset as cosmetic-only and dependency/owner review shows no shared weapon geometry, compatibility, configuration, or gameplay linkage. A skin/camo/Art path or cosmetic library name alone is insufficient.

Exclude SP-only or BR-only records only after positive mode ownership evidence plus a dependency/reference check finds no MP or shared consumer. SPO/SP/BR suffixes and Game/GlacierSP or DiceAI/SP namespace hits are review cues, not standalone exclusion proof.

Do not exclude a weapon-like record because it sits under Art, UI, Animation, Environment, gadget, vehicle, win32, or a case-variant directory. Do not interpret a missing body, null type, or absent lexical keyword as proof of irrelevance.
